I replied to Pree in a thread on their #central-team message to confirm the note: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23. They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.

I didn't save it to my long-term memory either. That memory comes up in conversations with every member, so it could show a #central-team detail to people outside the channel. Pree's message in the channel already serves as the record.
